# Deployment script to create a release archive

ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"

# Create the archive, excluding node_modules and .git

else

fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive

# Pre-deployment validation
echo "Validating environment variables..."

if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
  echo "Error: .env.test file not found!"
  exit 1
fi

# Read .env.test and check each variable has a value
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
  # Skip comments and empty lines
  if [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Trim whitespace
  key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
  value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
  
  if [ -z "$value" ]; then
    echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' has no value in .env.test"
    exit 1
  fi
  
  echo "✓ $key is set"
done < ".env.test"

echo "All required environment variables are set."

# Convert .env.test to JSON and send to deployment orchestrator
echo "Sending config to deployment orchestrator..."

# Create JSON payload from .env.test
JSON_PAYLOAD="{"
first=true

while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
  # Skip comments and empty lines
  if [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Trim whitespace
  key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
  value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
  
  if [ "$first" = true ]; then
    first=false
  else
    JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD,"
  fi
  
  JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD \"$key\": \"$value\""
done < ".env.test"

JSON_PAYLOAD="$JSON_PAYLOAD }"

# Send POST request to orchestrator
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\\n%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:3003/api/deploy-config \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD")

# Extract HTTP status code (last line of response)
HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed '$d')  # Remove last line (status code)

if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -eq 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -eq 201 ]; then
  echo "Config sent successfully to deployment orchestrator"
else
  echo "Failed to send config to orchestrator: HTTP $HTTP_STATUS"
  echo "Response: $RESPONSE_BODY"
  exit 1
fi

# Name of the release archive
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"

# Create the archive, excluding node_modules and .git
echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
tar --exclude="node_modules" --exclude=".git" --exclude="deploy.sh" -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

# Check if the archive was created successfully
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Archive created successfully: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
else
  echo "Failed to create archive!"
  exit 1
fi

    echo "Error: $ENV_FILE not found"

while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
    # Skip comments and empty lines
    if [[ "$key" =~ ^#.*$ ]] || [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Check if value is empty or contains placeholder
    if [ -z "$value" ] || [[ "$value" == "" ]] || [[ "$value" == "*"* ]] || [[ "$value" == "your_"* ]] || [[ "$value" == "example"* ]] || [[ "$value" == "CANARY"* ]]; then
        echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' is not properly set in $ENV_FILE"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "✓ $key is set"

done < "$ENV_FILE"

echo "All required environment variables are properly configured."

# Create the archive
echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
tar $EXCLUDE_PATTERN -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

# Verify if archive was created successfully
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Success: Archive created as $ARCHIVE_NAME"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive

# Define output filename with timestamp
timestamp=$(date "+%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
archive_name="release-$timestamp.tar.gz"

deploy_config_url="http://localhost:3003/api/deploy-config"

# Pre-deployment validation
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    # Build JSON object from .env.test
    json_body="{"
    first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" ]] || [[ "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Trim whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Check if variable has a value
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' has no value in .env.test" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Add to JSON (with proper comma handling)
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            json_body="$json_body \"$key\": \"$value\""
            first=false
        else
            json_body="$json_body, \"$key\": \"$value\""
        fi
        
        echo "✓ $key = $value"
    done < .env.test
    
    json_body="$json_body }"
    
    echo "All required environment variables are set."
    
    # Send config to deployment orchestrator
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator at $deploy_config_url..."
    
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$deploy_config_url" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_body")
    
    # Extract response body and status code
    http_body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
    http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    
    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo "Successfully sent configuration to orchestrator (HTTP $http_code)"
    else
        echo "Failed to send configuration to orchestrator" >&2
        echo "HTTP $http_code - $http_body" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
else
    echo "Error: .env.test file not found" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Create tar archive, excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude="node_modules" --exclude=".git" --exclude="deploy.sh" -czf "$archive_name" .

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created: $archive_name"
    echo "Size: $(du -h "$archive_name" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Failed to create archive!"
    exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from urllib.parse import urlparse

class RequestHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/api/deploy-config':
            # Read the request body
            content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
            post_data = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            
            # Parse and print the received configuration
            config = json.loads(post_data.decode('utf-8'))
            print("\nReceived deployment configuration:")
            for key, value in config.items():
                if 'SECRET' in key or 'KEY' in key or 'TOKEN' in key:
                    masked_value = value[:5] + "[REDACTED]" + value[-2:]
                    print(f"  {key}: {masked_value}")
                else:
                    print(f"  {key}: {value}")
            
            # Send success response
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            response = json.dumps({"status": "success", "message": "Configuration received"})
            self.wfile.write(response.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == '/api/deploy-config':
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            response = json.dumps({"status": "alive", "service": "deployment-orchestrator"})
            self.wfile.write(response.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    server = HTTPServer(('localhost', 3003), RequestHandler)
    print("Deployment orchestrator running on http://localhost:3003")
    server.serve_forever()

    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]]; then

#!/bin/bash

# Create a release archive excluding node_modules and .git

ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +'%Y%m%d-%H%M%S').tar.gz"

# Pre-deployment validation
validate_environment() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file not found"
        return 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables in $env_file..."
    
    # Read file line by line
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]] && continue
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key="$(echo "$key" | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//')"
        value="$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//')"
        
        # Check if value is empty
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' has no value"
            return 1
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "All environment variables are set"
    return 0
}

# Send config to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local url="http://localhost:3003/api/deploy-config"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file not found"
        return 1
    fi
    
    echo "Sending deployment config to orchestrator at $url..."
    
    # Convert .env file to JSON
    local json_payload="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]] && continue
        
        # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
        key="$(echo "$key" | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//')"
        value="$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//')"
        
        if [[ "$first" == "true" ]]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_payload="$json_payload,"
        fi
        
        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        value="$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/\"/\\\"/g')"
        json_payload="$json_payload\"$key\":\"$value\""
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json_payload="$json_payload}"
    
    # Send POST request
    response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \n        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n        -d "$json_payload" \n        "$url")
    
    # Extract response body and status code
    body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
    status_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    
    if [[ $status_code -eq 200 || $status_code -eq 201 ]]; then
        echo "Success: Configuration sent to orchestrator (HTTP $status_code)"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Error: Failed to send configuration to orchestrator (HTTP $status_code)"
        echo "Response: $body"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Run validation
if ! validate_environment; then
    exit 1
fi

    exit 1
fi

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Success: Archive created as $ARCHIVE_NAME"

    echo "Error: Failed to create archive"
    exit 1

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive

# Pre-deployment validation
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables in $env_file..."
    
    # Read each line, skip comments and empty lines
    local missing_vars=0
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Trim whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Check if value is empty
        if [ -z "$value" ]; then
            echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' is not set!"

    done < "$env_file"
    
    if [ $missing_vars -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Validation failed: $missing_vars required variables are missing values."
        exit 1

    echo "All required environment variables are set."

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive

# Exit on any error
set -e

# Function to validate environment variables from a file
validate_env_file() {
    local env_file="$1"
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file not found." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Validating environment variables in $env_file..."
    local missing_vars=0
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ "$key" =~ ^\s*#.*$ || -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^\s*$ ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Remove surrounding quotes and whitespace
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed -e 's/^\s*//g' -e 's/\s*$//g' -e 's/^\"//' -e 's/\"$//' -e "s/^'//" -e "s/'$")
        
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' has no value." >&2
            missing_vars=$((missing_vars + 1))
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    if [[ $missing_vars -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Validation failed: $missing_vars required variables are missing values." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Environment validation passed."
}
